mutants.description: The cast to TIMER_W is applied after the shift, so base_clks << strike_level is evaluated at HICCUP_BASE_W width and its top bits are lost before widening
mutants.reason: At strike level 1 or above with a base_clks whose upper bits are set (e.g. near HICCUP_BASE_MAX_CLKS), the target is truncated and hiccup_done asserts far earlier than base_clks*2^strike_level clocks.

mutants.description: Strike numbering misremembered as 1-based: the interval is base_clks doubled once even at strike level 0
mutants.reason: Every cool-down lasts twice as long as specified; at strike level 0 hiccup_done asserts after 2*base_clks clocks instead of base_clks.

mutants.description: Escalation made linear (base * (level+1)) instead of doubling per strike
mutants.reason: At strike levels 0 and 1 the interval is unchanged, but at strike level 2 hiccup_done asserts after 3*base_clks clocks instead of 4*base_clks.

mutants.description: The interval-reached check is given priority over the leave-S_HICCUP clear, so a finished cool-down is never re-armed
mutants.reason: After the first cool-down completes, hiccup_done stays high through S_SS and S_RUN, so the next entry into S_HICCUP sees hiccup_done already asserted and exits without any cool-down.

mutants.description: The counter and flag are cleared on leaving S_HICCUP only if the cool-down had finished; an early exit (g_en low, UVLO, OTP) leaves the counter running
mutants.reason: If the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP before the interval elapses, cool_counter keeps counting outside S_HICCUP and hiccup_done asserts while hiccup_active is low and stays set, so the next hiccup entry ends immediately.

mutants.description: hiccup_done is raised when the counter is about to reach the target instead of when it has reached it
mutants.reason: In every cool-down hiccup_done asserts one clock earlier than base_clks<<strike_level clocks after entry, shortening each hiccup by one clock.
